audience: teams that text customers, leads or clients from a TextUs inbox

useCases.title: Catch up on the unread conversations in an inbox
useCases.text: List the unread conversations of an account, newest first. Open the timeline of each one and ask the assistant for a short summary of what the contact wants.

useCases.title: Find a contact by phone number and review the history
useCases.text: Search the contacts by name or phone number. Read the contact data and the message history with that person before you call back.

useCases.title: Review how a bulk message campaign performed
useCases.text: List the campaigns of an account and open one to see its message, schedule and recipient counts. Then read the delivery statistics for all campaigns.

useCases.title: Check which phone numbers opted out before a send
useCases.text: List the numbers that opted out of messages, or search for one number. Use the list to remove those people from a planned group message.

useCases.title: Add a new lead as a contact and record a note
useCases.text: Create a contact from the details of a new lead. Then add an internal note with the context, so the next agent sees it. The contact does not see the note.
